title: Experimental and theoretical investigations of divinylbenzene-based polymer as an efficient adsorbent for brilliant green dye removal
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19843-19858
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02950C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marwa Magdy, Mohamed M. Aboelnga, Aya Deyab, Aliaa Semida, Rawan Rizk, Nada Elseady, Mona Abo Hashesh, Elsayed Elbayoumy
Poly(DVB) was synthesized and used for brilliant green dye removal. High efficiency (97.4%) was achieved via π–π interactions. DFT and isotherm analysis confirm chemisorption on a porous, reusable polymer surface.
